candidate.rationale: Replace the accepted icon with the standalone mark of the bank's own logo vector: it corrects the off-brand flat reds (#ED1C24/#B2212E/#D21924) to the official 2021-rebrand segmented palette (#ee3338/#d23238/#b4363f) and is backed by an original first-party vector; the same mark is in current use as the bank's official Telegram avatar (through 2026-09).
candidate.role: Standalone mark: red segmented pinwheel D with a white eight-point star; no lettering; the D contour is the emblem's own branded silhouette, not a backing.
transforms: Lossless whole-element selection from the original lockup vector: the mark groups (g20–g80, eight red pinwheel segments and eight white star triangles) are carried over verbatim; the wordmark groups were excluded; a square viewBox bounds the 90x90-unit mark; no path data, color or geometry was edited; no transformation of the emblem was needed.
